# Staged experiment report

The staged GRPO run is unhealthy. Held-out `val-core/hiyouga/geometry3k/acc/mean@1` stays flat (0.514 at step 0, 0.551 at step 5, then 0.524 / 0.529 / 0.532 at steps 10 / 15 / 20) while training `critic/score/mean` moves from 0.399 at step 1 to 0.591–0.720 later. Rollout/actor log-prob correlation stays about 0.992–0.994 and `rollout_corr/kl` stays about 0.005–0.008, so the actor is fitting the sampled tokens. It is not learning the geometry those tokens were scored on.

## Root cause

The FSDP actor monkey-patch replaces `Qwen3VLModel.forward` with `qwen3_vl_base_forward` (`verl/verl/models/transformers/qwen3_vl.py`). The recorded log shows that patch applied on every worker (`Monkey patch Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration model forward`) with `use_fused_kernels=False` and `use_remove_padding=True`.

`qwen3_vl_base_forward` built image embeddings and then called `self.language_model(...)` **without `position_ids`**. The FSDP remove-padding path (`prepare_model_inputs` in `verl/verl/workers/engine/fsdp/transformer_impl.py`) does pass them: for the agent-loop layout they are `(4, 1, total_nnz)` — one text row plus temporal / height / width. `Qwen3VLTextModel.forward` (transformers 4.57) splits a leading size-4 axis into the text positions used to detect packed sequences and the 3-row MRoPE consumed by `Qwen3VLTextRotaryEmbedding`. With `position_ids is None` it instead builds a single increasing index from `cache_position` and expands that index to all three rotary axes. Every image token in a geometry diagram then shares one rotary position, so height and width never enter the policy.

That matches the recorded behavior:

- The job finished all 20 steps. `train.log` has no `Image features and image tokens do not match`, so image features were inserted and token counts agreed. The failure is positional, not a dropped vision tensor.
- vLLM still sees the figure: the step-1 rollout describes the diagram and boxes an answer. The actor update does not, so the group reward can rise while held-out boxed accuracy stays near the step-0 rate (343/601, then 368, 350, 353, 355 of 601).
- Text tokens keep ordinary increasing positions either way, which is why rollout and actor log-probs stay highly correlated.

Response truncation (`response_length/max` always 8192, clip ratio about 0.03–0.16) is real but secondary: the base model already scores about 57% of the held-out set before any update, and the later evals do not move off that band.

## Changes

- `verl/verl/models/transformers/qwen3_vl.py`: `qwen3_vl_base_forward` now takes `position_ids` and passes them into `self.language_model`. The packed `(4, 1, total_nnz)` tensor is forwarded as-is; `Qwen3VLTextModel` already splits that layout into text positions and 3-row MRoPE. No launch, data, model, GPU, step, or log-path settings were changed.

## Expected effect

`val-core/hiyouga/geometry3k/acc/mean@1` (and the matching `val-aux/hiyouga/geometry3k/reward/mean@1`) should rise across the step-5 / 10 / 15 / 20 evals above the recorded flat band of about 0.51–0.55. Step 0 should stay near 0.514, since that eval is the untouched base model. Training `critic/score/mean` can keep rising; the change is that those gains should now show up on the held-out set.
